description: Invented workshop and garden records; questions and relevance labels authored from the stated facts, before running retrieval. No predecessor results or private data.

records.title: Water system maintenance
records.body: Before servicing the greenhouse irrigation pump, shut the blue isolation valve. Wait until the pressure gauge reads zero.

records.title: Seedling care
records.body: Feed the greenhouse tomato seedlings with diluted fertilizer once a week. Avoid wetting their leaves.

records.title: Electrical safety
records.body: Before replacing greenhouse lamps, switch off the lighting circuit breaker. The water supply can stay on.

records.title: Billing instructions
records.body: Payments for supplier invoices use account code FINCH47. Add the invoice number as the bank transfer reference.

records.title: Document storage
records.body: Archive supplier invoices in the green cabinet after matching them with delivery slips. Keep the paper copies for auditing.

records.title: Workshop coordination
records.body: For workshop schedule changes, email Mira Vale at mira.vale@example.test. She cannot take daytime telephone calls.

records.title: Delivery routing
records.body: Send workshop deliveries to the south gate. Ask the driver to ring the bell on arrival.

records.title: Tool access
records.body: The potting shed key is in the red tin beside the seed trays. Return it there after borrowing the tools.

records.title: House access
records.body: The spare front door key is in the blue tin on the kitchen shelf. It does not open the potting shed.

records.title: Waste sorting
records.body: Keep diseased tomato leaves out of the compost. Bag them for collection so the infection does not spread.
